assessment.nobel_worthiness: Cărtărescu has a highly distinctive voice. His densely patterned, visionary prose joins the body, memory, dream and metaphysical speculation in a sustained project. Blinding (the Orbitor triptych) and Solenoid show formal ambition at very large scale, and his work also includes poetry and essays. On the common criteria he scores strongly for distinctiveness, linguistic achievement and imaginative depth.
assessment.attribution: The credited writer is a single author. A citation would plausibly address the construction of an inner, cosmological world from personal and bodily experience through exceptionally elaborate prose. The scope is clear and matches the candidate's own body of work.
assessment.maturity: The oeuvre is long and has been consistent since the poetry and early prose of the 1980s, with the late large-scale novels as culminating works. It is a mature, durable body of work. Timing is not a constraint.
uncertainties: My assessment of the prose rests on translations and on public knowledge. The effect of Romanian syntax and rhythm in translation is uncertain.
I have not independently verified sources or read the full corpus, especially the poetry and the essays.
His excess and encyclopedic density could be weighed differently across the committee.

assessment.nobel_worthiness: Adonis is a major reshaper of modern Arabic poetic language. He draws on myth, fragmentation and a critical, sustained dialogue with inherited classical forms. Songs of Mihyar the Damascene and A Time Between Ashes and Roses are representative, and his essays on Arabic poetics extend the achievement into criticism. Formal and linguistic significance is very high.
assessment.attribution: The credited writer is a single poet-essayist. A citation could cover the renewal of Arabic poetry and of the Arabic poetic tradition through formal innovation, with essays as part of the contribution. The scope is coherent.
assessment.maturity: The work spans many decades and is widely discussed in Arabic literary culture. It has been durable and influential. He is very senior in age, so timing matters.
uncertainties: The poetry's musical and prosodic effects, and its relationship to classical forms, are only partly accessible in translation.
My knowledge of the essays and later collections is uneven.
Disputes over his political and cultural positions are context, not literary evidence, and I cannot assess them beyond the work.

assessment.nobel_worthiness: Zurita writes large poetic sequences, among them Purgatory and Anteparadise, that turn the suffering of the Pinochet era into collective, memorial form. His work includes landscape-scale and sky-writing interventions that extend poetry beyond the page. The voice is distinctive and the ambition formal and ethical. His achievement lies in poetic form, not in documentary witness alone.
assessment.attribution: The credited writer is a single poet. A citation could address poetry that turns historical catastrophe and vulnerability into monumental, visionary form. His works beyond the page are best treated as extensions of the poems, not as a separate field.
assessment.maturity: The work is sustained from the late 1970s to the present, with a recognizable development. It is durable and widely respected in Spanish-language poetry. Timing is open.
uncertainties: Translation of long, cumulative, visually structured poems is difficult, so my judgement of linguistic achievement carries extra uncertainty.
The landscape-scale and installation works may not be easy to weigh as literature within the will's framework.
I may have uneven knowledge of the later volumes.

assessment.nobel_worthiness: Michon's compressed, intensely worked prose makes obscure lives and art history into powerful narrative inquiry. Small Lives and The Eleven are the representative works. His stylistic rigor is very high, with a distinctive, almost sculpted syntax. The work is intellectually serious about the relation between art, origin and the unrecorded.
assessment.attribution: The credited writer is a single author. A citation could address a language of great economy and density that gives literary form to forgotten lives and to the making of art. The scope is narrow but precise.
assessment.maturity: The oeuvre is small in volume but consistent and mature. The quality is sustained. The relatively limited size may be weighed as a question of breadth.
uncertainties: The compression and syntax are highly language-dependent and may be partly lost in translation.
Whether the small corpus is broad enough for the prize is a legitimate open question.
I have not independently verified sources or read the full corpus.

assessment.nobel_worthiness: Can Xue writes dreamlike narrative worlds that destabilize ordinary psychology, space and causal storytelling. Frontier and Love in the New Millennium are representative. The voice is radically original within Chinese fiction, and the work is formally uncompromising and intellectually serious. It is persistent experimental writing, not a derivative of a Western mode.
assessment.attribution: The credited writer is a single author. A citation could address uncompromising experimental fiction that makes inner and imaginative reality a dominant form. The scope is clear.
assessment.maturity: The work is sustained over several decades with a consistent project. It is durable, though reception has been uneven. Timing is open.
uncertainties: I know the corpus mostly through a limited number of translated works, so coverage is partial.
Whether the translated English fully conveys the original's texture is uncertain.
The work is hard to interpret, which raises disagreement about its depth versus its repetition.

assessment.nobel_worthiness: Wright writes large, polyphonic narratives that remake the novel through Indigenous sovereignty, oral forms and ecological time. Carpentaria and The Swan Book are representative, and her nonfiction extends the project. The voice is distinctive and the formal ambition is high. It is significant beyond national frames.
assessment.attribution: The credited writer is a single author. A citation could address narrative forms that carry Aboriginal political and storytelling traditions into the contemporary novel. The scope is well defined.
assessment.maturity: The novel oeuvre is comparatively small, with two major novels and further nonfiction. She is mature but the body of work is still of moderate size. Timing is open.
uncertainties: The size of the corpus relative to others is a question for sustained quality.
I cannot independently judge the cultural contexts and oral traditions the work draws on.
My knowledge of her recent works is partial.

assessment.nobel_worthiness: Magris writes hybrid travel, essay and fiction that map Europe through borderlands, memory and intellectual history. Danube and Microcosms are representative. The achievement lies in a learned, flexible prose form and in sustained attention to Central European culture. The depth is intellectual as well as literary.
assessment.attribution: The credited writer is a single author. A citation could address the essayistic-narrative form for Central Europe and its cultural memory. The scope is clear, with the essays and fiction as a unity.
assessment.maturity: The work is long, consistent and recognized. It is mature and durable. Timing is open.
uncertainties: Part of the achievement is erudition and essayistic form, so weighing it against pure imaginative invention involves judgement.
I have limited access to the full Italian corpus and its academic works.
The thematic proximity of his subject to other writers on the longlist should not influence the assessment, and I have not let it.

assessment.nobel_worthiness: Murnane builds a radically inward fiction with distinctive systems of landscape, memory and mental images. The Plains and Border Districts are representative. The voice is unmistakable and the formal consistency is high. The writing is serious about how consciousness organizes experience, and is unusual in English-language fiction.
assessment.attribution: The credited writer is a single author. A citation could address an uncompromising, self-reflexive prose of memory and imagined space. The scope is coherent.
assessment.maturity: The oeuvre has developed across decades with strong internal consistency. The quality is sustained, though the range of subject matter is narrow by design. Timing is open.
uncertainties: The deliberate narrowness of themes raises the question of breadth and significance across a body of work.
I have not independently verified sources or read the full corpus.
Reception is concentrated in a limited readership, which I do not treat as evidence about merit.
